Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“The old stones remember what the new ones are pretending to be.”

Menhirkin (Sedimentary). Laid-down stone. Other Menhirkin are events; you are a record.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Strata Testimony. 1/Soma Break, touch a structure or formation older than a century. The GM tells you two true things: one about construction, one about the last decade of occupation. Stacks with the ancestry’s Land Memory.
  • Old Layer Resilience. At character creation, pick one damage type from {energy, poison, qliphothic}. You resist that type. Ask the GM to toggle it on your sheet’s base-defenses editor in edit mode (click the chip once).
  • Signature. You gain Read the Strata at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.title: Read the Strata
advancement.hint: Gain the Menhirkin (Sedimentary) signature feat: Read the Strata.
